name: speech
description: Speech to text, one record per over, by OpenAI's transcription API on your key: each over's squelch-open audio leaves this Mac for api.openai.com, or for the endpoint the key was added with

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: what the speech engine heard, as it wrote it

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language
fields.description: the language the engine transcribed, as an ISO 639-1 code

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: the model that produced the text

fields.name: confidence
fields.label: Confidence
fields.description: the engine's own confidence in the text, 0 to 1, when it reports one

fields.name: callsigns
fields.label: Callsigns
fields.description: callsigns in the text, comma-separated: a pattern match over the normalised text (prefix, one digit, 1 to 3 letters; a 4-letter suffix such as N0CALL is not matched), not a decoded identity

fields.name: continues
fields.label: Continues
fields.description: set on a record whose audio follows straight on from the record before: one long transmission, such as a channel whose squelch never closes, cut into pieces of at most 30 s
